# PhotoShelter Announces New CEO: Andrew Fingerman

## Co-Founder Allen Murabayashi shifts to Chairman of the Board

New York, NY, May 2, 2012 - PhotoShelter (), PhotoShelter, the leader in photography portfolio websites, sales, marketing and archiving tools announced today that Andrew Fingerman will be named the company’s new Chief Executive Officer. Andrew replaces PhotoShelter Co-Founder Allen Murabayashi who has led the company as CEO since its inception in 2005. Murabayashi will be moving to the Chairman of the Board role, focusing on strategic vision and an intensive schedule of photographer events and PhotoShelter speaking engagements. [...] Fingerman has served as PhotoShelter’s Vice President of Marketing for 4.5 years. He’s been responsible for the evolution of the PhotoShelter brand and the continuous growth of PhotoShelter customer base, which now stands at 74,000 photographers. Fingerman conceived and oversaw the development of PhotoShelter’s library of 20+ free photography business guides, the company’s popular webinar series, and has built and maintained strong relationships with the major photography industry trade associations. [...] #### About PhotoShelter

Images. At PhotoShelter, the word means so much more than a pretty picture -- it’s about improving the way millions of image creators, brands and businesses communicate in a visual world. It’s about harnessing the power of images easily, securely and affordably -- anytime, anywhere. It’s about using media in the most efficient way possible to tell your story and engage your audience. In essence, it’s about making visual assets more useful and valuable with cutting-edge image management technology. That’s what we’ve been doing for over 10 years. More than 80,000 professional photographers and 70 leading brands trust and rely on PhotoShelter to do just that every day, with over 200 million of their image assets. To learn more, visit .
